text:
Nadia R: Partner ops raised a billing mismatch — partner sees customers charged twice for same inference sessions. They claim devices emit on-device usage and when model falls back to cloud we also get cloud-usage events. Need to correlate so we don't double-bill.
Tom H: can you paste example events? sounds like we need to tie by session_id or request_id.
Nadia R: example (anonymized): ```
// device-side report
{
  "device_id": "edge-77A",
  "session_id": "sess-9f3a",
  "ts": "2026-06-12T08:12:05Z",
  "tokens_local": 850,
  "origin": "device"
}

// cloud-side fallback event
{
  "device_id": "edge-77A",
  "session_id": "sess-9f3a",
  "ts": "2026-06-12T08:12:07Z",
  "tokens_cloud": 870,
  "origin": "cloud-fallback"
}
``` Partner currently sends both into our marketplace as independent billable events.
Jules M: ah — same session_id, close timestamps. our billing pipeline treats device and cloud events as distinct SKUs so they both get billed. We should collapse by canonical_session and prefer cloud usage when origin=="cloud-fallback" (since cloud includes rerun tokens) or choose max(tokens_local, tokens_cloud). Agree need safe rule.
Priya S: product implications: if we collapse automatically, partner/customer impact depends on pricing model (device-tier vs cloud-tier). Need partner sign-off and clear audit trail in customer bill. Also some customers want both meters (charged for device+cloud) for different line-items. we must be careful.
Nadia R: partner says most customers expect single charge per interaction; they will map to one SKU eventually. short-term they'd rather have us provide consolidated billing and a visibility column.
Tom H: proposal: pipeline change: 1) ingest stage emits event_signature = sha256(device_id + session_id + floor(ts/60s)) 2) correlation stage groups events by event_signature within 30s window 3) if group contains both origins (device + cloud-fallback) mark consolidated_event with consolidated_tokens = max(tokens_local, tokens_cloud) and set consolidation_reason = "fallback_merge_v1" 4) write both originals to ledger with tags {"consolidated_id": id, "consolidated": true} so ledger isn't losing raw data.
Jules M: implementation detail: some devices don't provide session_id. fallback: correlate by nearest ts + sliding window + device-side request_id hash if available. fallback risk: false merges. we should only auto-consolidate when session_id exists OR when tokens are very similar and ts delta < 10s.
billing-bot: queued: create ticket BILL-8472 for consolidated-billing pipeline changes, assign to eng-billing. ETA triage 1d.
Priya S: billing sheet format request: consolidated rows should include constituent_event_ids column (semicolon-separated) and original_line_items preserved. example CSV columns: customer_id, invoice_period_start, invoice_period_end, consolidated_id, total_billed_tokens, constituent_event_ids, reasons, audit_hash.
Tom H: backfill plan for already-billed duplicates: 1) scan last 30 days for groups with both device+cloud events that likely match 2) compute delta between billed_sum and consolidated_sum 3) create provisional credit file and share with partner ops & finance for sign-off 4) if approved, issue credits in next billing run and attach audit CSV.
Nadia R: partner can enable session_id propagation in next firmware in 3 weeks for all new devices, but they can flip a flag to enable for a 10% pilot tomorrow. we'll run consolidation on pilot and compare outcomes.
Jules M: add metrics: duplicate_rate_by_partner, average_tokens_delta_when_dup, pct_consolidated_auto_vs_manual. surface in marketplace dashboard with a link to raw events for manual audit.
Tom H: I'll scope the change. eng-billing — can you estimate hours for a safe deploy with feature flag?
billing-bot: BILL-8472 updated: estimated 2.5 dev-days + 1 day testing + staging run. feature flag gating required.
Priya S: i'll draft partner comms and a customer-facing FAQ that explains consolidated billing behavior and timeline. send draft to legal/finance for approval.
Nadia R: thanks all. i'll spin up the pilot cohort and will post pilot IDs here plus expected sample output once we run staging. :rocket:
